title: villager plus
description: This project adds new professions to the residents (14 pieces) to such items as: chest, beehive, stove, enchantment table, target, music block, turntable,caster,chalker,bookshelf, patterned base, bee nest, anvil and workbench.
body: <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hNBSls5RpDM" title="Проигрыватель YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>This project adds new professions for residents (14 pieces) to items such as: a chest, a beehive, an oven, a spell table, a target, a music block, a turntable, a spell caster, a chalkmaker, a bookshelf, a stand with a pattern, a bee nest, an anvil and a workbench. To be more precise, new blocks for professions have been added, since the minecraft game code indicates that the bee nest and hive block are occupied. And this project also has unique features for each new commercial villager. For a more unique trade, new items such as marshmallows or different honey have been added. A new currency has been added to get it, you need to approach a merchant villager with the profession <bank>, but in order to get other coins, you need to upgrade the merchant villager at each level, the villager can make the coin better. In this project, residents sell you items (or something else) and make a commission in their trade. Another ingot will amount to 15 coins.
